web.why: the federal medical assistance percentage (section 1396d(b) of title 42 of the United States Code) fixes the federal government's share of each state's Medicaid spending for the people covered. By its terms it moves who pays, not who is covered or what care they get; the expansion and the work requirement set those (their links medicaid-expansion-to-coverage, medicaid-expansion-to-mortality, medicaid-expansion-to-medical-debt and work-requirement-to-coverage). The researched response to the subsidy is in the states' own spending: an elasticity of Medicaid spending per enrollee of -0.494 to -0.579 with respect to the after-subsidy price (Bundorf and Kessler 2021, NBER Working Paper 29492, abstract). That is a budget decision of the state's body, not a place outcome the web keeps. The dollars the match moves are on the journal (the money link).

rows.name: clean air plan for polluted counties

money.why: The clean air plan question moves no payment of its own in the game's model. EPA designates the nonattainment areas and the duty on their stationary sources follows the designation (Clean Air Act sec. 107(d) and 172, 42 U.S.C. 7407(d) and 7502), and where a state has no plan the federal plan applies instead (sec. 110(c), 42 U.S.C. 7410(c)), so the sources are charged either way. The engine does the same: src/core2/modules/business.ts:937 sets the share from the county's missed standards alone, :949-951 uses the plan's law row only for the citation when one is in force, and :959 makes the charge with or without it (tested in src/core2/clean-air-law.test.ts; the earlier ruling is pool item laws-family-clean-air, 'the cost is federal either way'). What the plan changes is the air, through the outcome web (emission-rules-to-particulates). In the drawn places for this law no journal post differs from the control world; the audit-town reading that looked like money (Uehling, Nebraska: interest-group-dues, journal:2025-02-01:1885, 400000 in the control world against 250000 with the plan in force) is interest groups' dues, not a payment the plan causes.

repeal.why: A claimant's benefit rights are determined when the claim is established and benefits are payable during the benefit year (U.S. Department of Labor, Comparison of State Unemployment Insurance Laws 2021, chapter 3, Monetary Entitlement: "An individual's benefit rights are determined using wages and employment from a specific period of time called a base-period. Putting the old terms back governs the claims filed after it; a claim already filed keeps being paid, and recorded, on the terms it was filed under.
